# volcano_project_deployments (Data Source)

Deployment history across every deployable resource (functions, durable functions, frontends) in a project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "volcano_project_deployments" "example" {
  project_id = volcano_project.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
